                               THE WESTPORT, UNIT #607
                                     500 W. 56th Street, Clinton, Manhattan




  Amenities: 24hr Attended Lobby, Resident Manager, Rooftop Sundeck. Fitness Center*, Basketball Court*,
                Business Center*, Entertainment Room with a BBQ Garden*. (*fee required)

Transit: 1,2,A,B,C,D,E M11, M12, M31, M50, M57
                          No application fee • No broker’s fee • Pet friendly building
Applications are now being accepted to fill a vacancy on a first come, first served basis. Individuals or households
who meet the income and household size requirements listed in the table below may apply. Qualified applicants
will be required to meet additional selection criteria such as asset limits. Once the unit is filled there will be no
waitlist, this application is only for unit #607.

New York City is committed to the principle of inclusivity in all of its neighborhoods, including supporting New
Yorkers to reside in neighborhoods of their choice, regardless of their neighborhood of origin and regardless of
the neighborhood into which they want to move.
